page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Margin notes stand in the right margin, beside lines 7 and 8. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. A small figure "82" at bottom right. No catchword.

main_text.p: subrecto,majori cum damno bonas horas male collocantem? Nihil profecto minùs; sed in Templo, in Patris sacrario, in Doctorum medio, audientem ipsos & interrogantem: Verùm si quamplurimos e nostris Parentes diutiùs hac in loco investigarent, vbi quaeso invenirent? Cùm legimus apud Cassianum, & SocratesCollat.11.5.4. de Cheremonis dorso, jugi jejunio, oratione, etHist Ecclesiast. l.4.5.18. vigiliis incurvato: De Pior, qui nunquam sedebat ad mensam, sed obambulans comedebat, ne jacturam temporis faceret (vt ille aestimavit) in opere superfluo. De Macario, qui serió protestabatur, se nunquam edidisse, bibisse aut dormivisse ad satietatem. De Pambo-ne, qui flevit ad conspectum ceruffata et calamistratae meretricis, quia tam pulchra esca apponeretur Diabolo, quae impensiùs studuisset, Hominibus placere, quàm ille vnquam Deo: Non possumus non reputare, aut illos alia scalâ coelum ascendisse, aut nos invenisse compendiosiorem. Quid? Iulianus Apostata perpetuum profitetur se Bellum ventri indicere, & nos Helluabimur & pergracabimur, ad loci, in quo vivimus, et totius professionis opprobrium? Sed caperata ista forsan Prifcorum Austeritas.

page.notes: Lower right of the page carries a figure "82", which I read as a printed page reference, not a gathering signature, so it is not given as a signature. Left margin shows a stain and bottom-left marks, not text. "Piore" and "mistratae" are read from a faint scan; "Piore" may be "Pior" with a stroke. "ne jacturam" is read as "ne" without accent; the printed accent is unclear. Right-margin notes are placed beside the lines they stand against. A small ornament mark in the right margin, lower half, is not text.
